headline: Zelenskiy Says US Ballistic Missile Warning Sharing Has Resumed
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated that United States early warning intelligence regarding incoming Russian ballistic missile strikes has fully resumed.
why: Military intelligence sharing and air defense support between Washington and Kyiv remain central to protecting Ukrainian energy and industrial infrastructure during the ongoing conflict.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Restored ballistic strike warnings improve defense readiness and reduce vulnerability for key domestic infrastructure.
